items.raw_excerpt: A Jewish New Year celebration in Phuket was cancelled at the last minute on Friday evening because of concerns raised by Israeli security officials, organisers said.
items.summary_en: Organizers cancelled a Jewish New Year celebration in Phuket at the last minute on Friday evening. They said Israeli security officials raised concerns about the event. The celebration was called off before it could take place.
items.summary_ko: 조직 측은 금요일 저녁 마지막 순간에 푸켓의 유대인 새해 축제를 취소했다고 밝혔다. 이스라엘 보안 관계자들이 우려를 제기했기 때문이다. 축제는 시작되기 전에 무산됐다.
items.title_en: Phuket Jewish New Year event cancelled over security worries
items.title_ko: 푸켓 유대인 새해 축제, 보안 우려로 취소
items.title_original: Phuket Jewish New Year event cancelled on security grounds

items.raw_excerpt: Users in Singapore spent an estimated US$18.8 million on OnlyFans in the platform's most recent audited financial year, ranking 17th in the world for spending per adult.
items.summary_en: Users in Singapore spent about 18.8 million US dollars on OnlyFans in the latest financial year. This ranks 17th in the world for spending per adult.

items.title_en: Singapore ranks 17th in world for OnlyFans spending

items.raw_excerpt: Taiwan's traditional temple culture was showcased in the Polish city of Lodz on Friday, drawing crowds with traditional music, deity processions, performances and a Taiwan-themed market.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's temple culture came to Lodz, Poland on Friday. Crowds enjoyed traditional music, deity processions, performances, and a Taiwan-themed market.
items.summary_ko: 대만의 전통 사찰 문화가 금요일 폴란드 우치에서 선보였습니다. 관람객들은 전통 음악과 신상 행렬, 공연, 그리고 대만 테마 시장을 즐겼습니다.
items.title_en: Taiwan temple culture showcased in Poland
items.title_original: Taiwan temple culture showcased in Poland

items.raw_excerpt: Keralam's EV owners face anxiety over frequent power outages disrupting charging schedules and impacting vehicle readiness for daily use.
items.summary_en: Frequent power outages in Kerala are disrupting electric vehicle charging schedules. EV owners say the blackouts affect how ready their cars are for daily use.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라에서 잦은 정전이 전기차 충전 일정을 어지럽히고 있습니다. 전기차 주인들은 매일 쓰는 차량의 준비 상태까지 영향을 받는다고 말합니다.
items.title_en: Kerala's EV owners worry over power cuts hurting charging

items.title_original: Frequent power outages leave Keralam’s EV owners anxious over charging woes

items.raw_excerpt: Hace casi una década, Eli decidió instalarse en Allepuz, una pequeña localidad aragonesa, junto a sus cinco hijos y su marido
items.summary_en: Almost a decade ago, Eli moved with her husband and five children to Allepuz, a small village in Aragon. She says they met their expectations and are still living there. Her family traded city life in Valencia for a fresh start in the countryside.
items.summary_ko: 거의 10년 전, 엘리는 남편과 다섯 아이와 함께 아라곤 지역의 작은 마을 알레푸스로 이사했다. 그녀는 기대에 부응했고 여전히 그곳에서 살고 있다고 말한다. 발렌시아의 도시 생활을 뒤로하고 시골에서 새 출발을 한 가족 이야기다.
items.title_en: She leaves her life in Valencia to move with her five children to a village in Teruel
items.title_ko: 다섯 아이와 함께 발렌시아 생활을 정리하고 테루엘의 작은 마을로 이사한 엘리의 이야기
items.title_original: Deja su vida en Valencia para mudarse con sus cinco hijos a un pueblo de Teruel y sentencia: «Cumplimos las expectativas y aquí seguimos» - ABC

items.raw_excerpt: The IF Illustration Festival, hosted by French illustration magazine Kiblind, will feature Taiwan as its theme country on Sept. 26-27 in Lyon, France.
items.summary_en: The IF Illustration Festival will feature Taiwan as its theme country. The event runs Sept. 26-27 in Lyon, France. It is hosted by the French illustration magazine Kiblind.

items.raw_excerpt: George and Travis break down Mexico's tipping culture in a new episode of the "Confidently Wrong" podcast.
items.summary_en: George and Travis talk about tipping in Mexico in a new episode of the 'Confidently Wrong' podcast. They explain how much to tip and when to tip in Mexico. The episode comes from Mexico News Daily.
items.summary_ko: 조지와 트래비스가 새 팟캐스트 '컨피던틀리 롱'에서 멕시코의 팁 문화를 다룹니다. 멕시코에서 팁을 얼마나, 언제 줘야 하는지 쉽게 설명합니다. 멕시코 뉴스 데일리가 만든 새로운 에피소드입니다.
items.title_en: New Podcast Explains Mexico's Tipping Culture

items.raw_excerpt: Around 70 SÁÁ employees have declared no confidence in its chair and executive board. The full board will meet Monday.
items.summary_en: About 70 employees of the SÁÁ organization in Iceland said they do not trust their chair and board leaders. The full board will hold a meeting on Monday to address the situation.
items.summary_ko: 아이슬란드의 SÁÁ 소속 직원 약 70명이 의장과 이사회 지도부에 대한 불신임을 표명했습니다. 전체 이사회는 이번 주 월요일에 회의를 열어 대응할 예정입니다.
items.title_en: SÁÁ Staff Lose Confidence in Leaders
items.title_original: SÁÁ Staff Declare No Confidence in Leadership

items.raw_excerpt: State-owned oil supplier CPC Corp., Taiwan announced Saturday that it will raise domestic gasoline prices by NT$0.7 (US$0.02) per liter and diesel prices by NT$0.6 per liter next week after international crude oil prices rose above US$100 per barrel this week.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's state-owned oil supplier CPC Corp. will raise domestic gasoline prices by NT$0.7 per liter and diesel prices by NT$0.6 per liter next week. The price increase follows international crude oil prices rising above US$100 per barrel.
items.summary_ko: 대만 국영 석유회사 CPC가 다음 주 국내 휘발유 가격을 리터당 NT$0.7, 경유 가격을 리터당 NT$0.6 인상한다고 발표했다. 이번 인상은 국제 원유가가 배럴당 100달러를 초과한 데 따른 것이다.
items.title_en: CPC to raise domestic gasoline, diesel prices next week
items.title_ko: 대만 CPC, 다음 주 국내 휘발유·경유 가격 인상
items.title_original: CPC to raise domestic gasoline, diesel prices next week

items.raw_excerpt: The Socialist Party is promoting an urgent debate next week in the Regional Legislative Assembly on the state of Azorean agriculture and rising costs in the primary sector.
items.summary_en: Lawmakers in the Azores will hold an urgent debate next week on the state of local agriculture. Rising costs are hurting farmers and fishermen across the islands.

items.title_en: Azores region debates fishing and farming cost crisis

items.summary_en: Overnight on Monday September 14, all westbound traffic on Thessaloniki's inner ring road will be closed between overpasses K10 and K9. Vehicles will be diverted through nearby streets and returned to the ring road at K9. Eastbound traffic will not be affected.
items.summary_ko: 9월 14일 월요일 밤 11시부터 다음 날 오전 5시까지 테살로니키 내부 순환도로 서쪽 방향 전 구간의 차량 통행이 전면 중단됩니다. 우회도로를 통해 교통이 안내되며, 동쪽 방향은 정상 운행됩니다.
items.title_en: Temporary Traffic Changes on Thessaloniki Ring Road Overnight Monday

items.raw_excerpt: Norway is preparing stricter regulation of smart glasses amid concerns about privacy and surveillance.
items.summary_en: Norway is preparing new regulations for smart glasses to protect privacy and prevent surveillance. The government is concerned about cameras and sensors in these devices being used to record people without their knowledge. Stricter rules would set limits on how smart glasses can be used in public spaces.
items.summary_ko: 노르웨이가 개인정보와 감시 문제를 우려해 스마트 안경에 대한 새로운 규제를 준비하고 있습니다. 정부는 이러한 기기에 탑재된 카메라와 센서가 사람들의 동의 없이 녹화되는 데 대한 우려를 표명했습니다. 더 엄격한 규칙은 공공장소에서 스마트 안경의 사용에 대한 제한을 설정할 것입니다.
items.title_en: Norway plans stricter rules for smart glasses
items.title_ko: 노르웨이, 스마트 안경 규제 강화 준비
items.title_original: Stricter rules planned for smart glasses

items.raw_excerpt: AmaZulu King Misuzulu kaZwelithini will later present the girls and young women with reeds.
items.summary_en: Thousands of people gathered in KwaZulu-Natal for the annual Reed Dance ceremony. AmaZulu King Misuzulu kaZwelithini will present the girls and young women with reeds. The event is a celebration of culture and tradition.
